sentences.text: Saiful Islam vs Unknown on 14 June, 2024

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
14.06.2024 rc/ct.no.34 Item No.21 Crr No. 2303 of 2024 In the matter of : Saiful Islam
.......Petitioner Mr. Sabir Ahmed Ms. Debasree Dhamali Mr. Tasnim Ahmed Mr. Dhiman Banerjee
...for the Petitioner

The petitioner has assailed the judgment passed by the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, 2 nd Court, Alipore, South 24-Parganas on December 17, 2021 in Criminal Revision No. 16 of 2021 affirming the judgment and order passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class 3rd Court, Asansol in Misc. Case No. 219 of 2004 primarily on the ground that in disposing of G.R.Case No. 376 of 2009 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code filed by the private opposite party against the petitioner, the learned trial court has held that the marriage between the parties is doubtful.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, 2 nd Court, Alipore, South 24-Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It appears that the petitioner has been able to make out an arguable case.
The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite party and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" on September 11, 2024.

The judgment and order passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class 3rd Court, Asansol in Misc. Case No. 219 of 2004 and Misc. Execution Case No. 119 of 2021 pending before the said learned Court be stayed till September 30, 2024 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

(Suvra Ghosh,J)
